name: Ninja Time [RELEASED]
desc:
🍥🍜 Dive into a massive open-world adventure where you become a Shinobi in a world shaped by ancient clans, powerful bloodlines, and elemental mastery. 

🦊 Whether you want to become a rogue warrior feared across the lands or a village protector known for your honor, the choice is yours...

⭐ Day Bonus
Mon-Tue: 1.5x Toki
Wed-Thurs: 1.5x BOSS DROPS 
Friday-Sun: 2x XP
